name: Armizan Mohd Ali
_note: M2 full-cabinet completion: Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living, held on an acting basis from July 2023 and confirmed permanently in the 12 Dec 2023 reshuffle (he also held Sabah and Sarawak Affairs in the Prime Minister's Department, Dec 2022-Dec 2023). Objective spine plus a provisional Layer B pass on file; below ranking validity pending remaining objective dimensions and an independent Layer B panel. Layer B (Editorial Panel) is a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score.

periods.office: Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living

metrics.justification: No personal corruption charge or conviction of record. A 2025 Sabah mineral-licence allegation circulated on social media was denied by him and produced no charge; the Prime Minister stated on 16 Nov 2025 there was "no conclusive evidence," while two state assemblymen (not him) were charged. Recorded as the subject's own status: an unproven allegation, not a charge, is not held against him.

citation.title: Anwar says no 'conclusive evidence' in Sabah mining scandal, draws the red line at court charges

metrics.justification: Managed cost-of-living and subsidy-transition shocks: monitored the targeted RON95 rollout to curb leakage, ran anti-profiteering enforcement (Ops Kesan) around the sales-and-service-tax revision (1,016 premises inspected, July 2025), and phased out the egg subsidy while retaining a price ceiling. Documented enforcement activity, deterrent outcomes mixed (anchor 2).

citation.title: SST: 1,016 premises inspected, 24 notices issued in Ops Kesan — Armizan

metrics.justification: Implemented the targeted diesel subsidy mechanism (SKDS 2.0 / Budi Madani, with RM200/month cash for eligible users, from 2024) and the targeted RON95 (BUDI95) subsidy live from 30 Sep 2025; subsidised cooking-oil leakage controls were still being developed. Major subsidy-rationalisation reforms operative, pricing set jointly with the finance ministry (anchor 3).

citation.title: Choose SKDS 2.0 or Budi Madani for diesel subsidies, not both, Armizan tells applicants

metrics.justification: Launched the KITA GEMPUR enforcement initiative (19 Oct 2024) against subsidised-goods manipulation and moved to amend cooking-gas rules for Sabah conditions. New enforcement programmes within the ministry, not a documented cross-bench or federal-state institutional strengthening (anchor 2).

citation.title: Ministry cripples syndicate allegedly embezzling subsidised cooking oil

metrics.justification: On the egg-subsidy phase-out (May-Aug 2025) he announced the cut openly and explained that a retained price ceiling would prevent uncontrolled hikes, rather than burying the change. Communicated a policy change with a rationale, the no-hike reassurance his own claim (anchor 2).

citation.title: Putrajaya says chicken eggs to remain under price control despite subsidy cut
